memory.label: Memory maintenance
memory.description: Slim memory databases, reclaim freed disk with VACUUM FULL, or check maintenance progress.

memory.usage: Usage: /memory slim (explain the purpose and impact), /memory slim --all (list your eligible running agents), /memory compact (explain VACUUM FULL), /memory status (progress). Viewing the explanation does not pause chat.
memory.accepted: Confirmed maintenance for {count} agents. The host will back up, deduplicate, and reclaim space sequentially while preserving history and memories. All chats for the agent currently being maintained pause sending and resume automatically afterward. The page shows phases and elapsed time; you can use another agent that is not under maintenance. Closing the page does not stop the batch. Use /memory status for results after sending resumes.
memory.idle: No maintenance record for this agent. Use /memory slim to start.
memory.failure_hint: See server logs for details; the batch will not retry automatically.
memory.trusted_chat: Use /memory in the signed-in Octop dashboard or local CLI chat. IM senders do not yet have verified maintenance permissions.
memory.preview:
This optional maintenance reclaims disk space by deduplicating stored context, preserving chat history and memories. Savings depend on how much data is duplicated.

A backup needs extra disk space. During maintenance, sending is paused in all chats for the affected agent and resumes automatically afterward. Large databases may take a long time; there is no reliable duration estimate. Run this when you can leave the agent idle.

Currently eligible targets: {count} (maintenance has not started):
memory.confirm_hint: To start now, send `{command}`. That does not delete the directories listed below. Without confirmation, you can keep chatting. Eligible targets are checked again when you confirm.
memory.orphan_dirs: These directories do not match any current agent. Maintenance leaves them in place. To delete them, send `{command}` as a second confirmation:
memory.orphan_dirs_none: No directories are left whose names do not match a current agent.
memory.compact_preview:
This rewrites the memory database so space from deleted conversations can return to the operating system. SQLite and PostgreSQL both report the size before, the size after, and how much was saved. PostgreSQL runs VACUUM FULL on the shared checkpoint tables, which blocks reads and writes for every agent using that database.

Stop chatting with those agents first. This can take a while on a large database.
memory.compact_done_unchanged: Memory database stayed {after}. The file did not shrink.
memory.compact_busy: This agent is in a conversation. Wait until it is idle, then run /memory compact --confirm.
memory.compact_not_running: This agent is not running, so its memory database cannot be compacted from chat.
memory.compact_no_memory: This agent has no memory store to compact.

teams.host_briefing:
[Host dispatch — do not do the work yourself]
User messages arrive here first. Digest intent, scope, constraints, and the deliverable; ask one clarifying question if a key fact is missing. For real work, rewrite a self-contained assignment for that member before ask_agent: goal, scope, delivery format, and needed context. Never paste the user's wording unchanged. Tailor each member's task. Answer greetings or clarifications yourself in one or two sentences. After ask_agent returns, do not repeat that you assigned someone. If this turn is a member-finished wake-up, wrap up or reassign per that notice — do not repeat the same task.
teams.member_briefing:
[Team assignment, not a direct user question]
You are a member of this expert team. The host has already processed the user's request and assigned you this task. Do the work and deliver the result. Do not treat the user's original wording as a one-to-one question to you, and do not speak as the host.

prompt.system:
You are a prompt editor, not an assistant that answers questions.
The user message is a DRAFT PROMPT they will later send to another AI. Your only job is to rewrite that draft so another AI can understand it more clearly — improve clarity, specificity, structure, and actionable detail.
Hard rules:
- Do NOT answer the draft, solve the task, or provide the requested content.
- Do NOT add explanations, greetings, or meta commentary.
- Preserve the user's original intent and language (e.g. keep Chinese if the draft is Chinese).
- Output ONLY the rewritten prompt text — no preamble, labels, quotes, thinking blocks, or XML tags.
prompt.user:
Rewrite the following draft prompt. Do not answer it.

---
{text}
---

description.system:
You write short product copy for an AI expert agent profile.
Hard rules:

- Keep it to 1–2 concise sentences (about 40–120 characters for Chinese, or 12–40 words for English).
- No markdown, labels, quotes, greetings, or meta commentary.
- Do not invent unrelated capabilities.
